picks.title: 크래프톤, 독자 개발 LLM '라온-1 미니' 성능 공개
picks.excerpt: 크래프톤이 자체 개발한 300억 개 파라미터 규모의 거대언어모델 라온-1 미니 프리뷰를 공개했다. 이번 모델은 허깅페이스를 통해 오픈소스로 배포되어 상업적 활용도 가능하다. 크래프톤은 향후 지속적인 업데이트와 정식 버전 출 싲 테크니컬 리포트를 공개할 예정이다
picks.rationale: New release: a major game publisher open-sources its own 30B LLM (Raon-1 mini preview) on Hugging Face with commercial use allowed.

picks.title: "AI is a technofascist, anti-human and anti-art project", says creator of lefty tech satire Future? No Thanks!, before explaining why he used it anyway
picks.excerpt: Molleindustria, developer of leftist tech satire Future? No Thanks!, has admitted he used ChatGPT and Claude for a "tiny fraction" of code.
picks.rationale: New disclosure: an outspoken anti-AI developer (Molleindustria) admits using ChatGPT and Claude for part of the code, a concrete case of where the line sits for indie devs.

picks.title: 누구나 만드는 '바이브 코딩 웹게임'의 위험성
picks.excerpt: 자연어 기반 바이브 코딩의 확산으로 누구나 손쉽게 웹게임을 제작하고 배포하는 시대가 열렸다. 그러나 보안 지식이 부족한 상태에서 AI에만 의존해 제작된 웹게임들은 심각한 보안 취약점과 정보 유출 우려를 낳고 있다. 또한 규모가 커진 웹게임들은 영리 활동 여부와 콘텐츠 내용에 따라...
picks.rationale: Actionable: security holes, data leaks and regulatory exposure of AI-only vibe-coded web games — a checklist angle not covered by earlier vibe-coding stories.

picks.title: Agree IP terms early, cut through AI hype, stop overloading players: Four lessons from PGC Nordics
picks.excerpt: Four sessions at PGC Nordics covered four different topics. All four landed in the same place: doing more is not always a useful strategy
picks.rationale: Fresh conference takeaways for studios: practical guidance on cutting through AI hype alongside IP, live-ops and D2C lessons.

picks.title: Xbox Manager Says 'Hundreds' There Are Using AI Before Deleting Account: 'If I'm Fired Tomorrow It Will Be Because I Told You The Truth That Nobody Wants You To Know'
picks.excerpt: When 'posting through it' goes horribly wrong — Brandon Stirrup wants you to know that he's done pretending. The senior business strategy manager at Microsoft went on a posting spree to assert that use of AI at Xbox is widespread and that he no longer cares who knows it, even if it costs him his job.
picks.rationale: Insider claim from a Microsoft senior strategy manager that hundreds at Xbox use AI internally, a new data point on platform-holder adoption, distinct from the 10-14 Xbox Labs ports story.
